description: This file defines the ProfileViewModel class, which manages user profile data and interacts with a ProfileRepository for loading and updating profile information. It acts as a state management component in a Flutter application, handling loading states, errors, and profile data.

classes.name: ProfileViewModel
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages user profile state and interactions with the profile repository.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the user profile; initiates repository seed if empty; updates loading state and error messages.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the user profile with provided details; manages loading and error states; returns success status.

methods.name: clearError
methods.description: Clears the current error message from the view model.
